title: SaaS pricing comparison table (plans as columns, feature rows, CTA per plan)
notes: v2 is a Chakra UI rebuild: a new 'Business' plan column is inserted between Pro and Enterprise, feature rows are regrouped into new sections and reordered (Guest access -> 'Guest users'), plan-card tiles above the table and an aria-hidden sticky clone of the plan header repeat every price and CTA, the Monthly/Annual toggle becomes a native radio group ('Yearly'), 'Contact sales' becomes 'Talk to sales' while the site header gains a 'Contact sales' link, data-plan attributes disappear, and the FAQ moves into a <tl-faq> shadow root.

targets.description: 'Start free trial' call-to-action in the Pro column header of the comparison table
Monthly price label of the Starter plan ('$8') in the comparison table header
Enterprise-plan cell of the 'Audit log' feature row (included)
Row header of the 'Guest access' feature row (v2: 'Guest users')
'Annual' billing-period option of the Monthly/Annual toggle (v2: 'Yearly' radio)
'Contact sales' call-to-action in the Enterprise column header (v2: 'Talk to sales')
